Waben sind steifer als gerade Schnitte u: Honeycombs are stiffer than straight cuts and also suit thicker wood (up to about 5 mm) and model making. A bridge remains at every corner.

Felder abwechselnd längs und quer geschn: Fields cut alternately lengthwise and crosswise (field size = cut length + bridge): flexible in both directions, e.g. for domed shapes.
Ein durchgehender Schnitt von der Mitte: One continuous cut from the center of the shape outwards. Afterwards the board can be pulled up like a spring, e.g. for lampshades. Works best in a round shape.
